title: The spec delta named Linux scenarios for CP7 and CP9 but none for CP8, the populated containment without a handle
resolution: Added the scenario for CP8 with an unproven start and renamed the CP9 scenario to tell the two populated rows apart.

title: The proposal's capability line listed only CP7 and CP9 as the new Linux scenarios
resolution: Named CP7, CP8, and CP9 in the proposal and in design decision 1.

title: The independent review section was a placeholder naming the reviewer that never ran
resolution: Recorded the failed attempt of the first reviewer, the switch, and pass 1 with its session, snapshots, and findings.

title: The shellcheck source directives named a path that resolves neither from the repository root nor inside the image
resolution: Pointed the directive in both entry points at tools/linux-cgroup/cgroup-layout.sh, which resolves when shellcheck runs from the repository root as make does.

title: The Linux crash windows script mounted the services secrets without checking that their variable is set
resolution: The script now exits 2 with a message that names the variable when it is unset.
